sara: Morning handoff — quick summary of overnight incident and current posture. Primary: jon (today). Secondary: kevin. Incident summary: model-router returned intermittent 503s for gen requests in eu-west between ~02:12–03:45 UTC. Impact: ~8% 5xx rate at peak for r/west1, some client retries, p95 gen latency spiked to ~2.4s. Suspected cause: autoscaler metrics under-reporting GPU utilization during a config rollout which caused instances to be marked draining during active traffic. Mitigations applied: reverted autoscaler config (PR #4231), manually added +4 nodes to model pool, enabled routing to us-central fallback variant, and kicked off KV cache rewarm. Current status: errors down to ~0.6% in r/west1, p95 down to ~1.1s, no active P1s. Next steps listed below.

incident-bot: Pager opened at 3123456100 — INC-2026-034. Total pages: 15. Alert rule: model-router.euwest.5xx > 5% for 5m.

jon: I'm on deck. I peeked at router logs and node churn. First hour actions: validate autoscaler probe behavior, confirm rollback completed, check for stuck drains, verify fallback routing is healthy. If 5xx > 2% I'll re-route more traffic to fallback and escalate infra. @kevin pls own customer comms while I dig.

kevin: Will standby for comms. Drafted message for affected customers: https://redwood.internal/updates/INC-2026-034 (SOC review pending). I'll send once we hit T+90m stable window.

maria: Quick data point from logs: consistent drainTimeout spikes in router-agent: ```/var/log/router-agent.log
Feb 14 02:14:12 router-agent[1234]: WARN drainTimeout exceeded for instance i-0abcd1234: 9.7s
Feb 14 02:16:03 router-agent[1234]: WARN drainTimeout exceeded for instance i-0efgh5678: 10.2s
``` Looks like healthcheck grace isn't compensating for the node shutdown timing.

sara: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-routing-fallback — follow steps 1–5 (validate fallback, drain checks, rollback, manual scale, monitor). Also pinned playbook in #eng-oncall.

jon: Commands I ran to validate state: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n model-router -o wide
curl -sS https://router-west1.internal/health | jq .
# health output we saw: {"status":"degraded","active_workers":18,"pending_restart":2}
``` Verified PR #4231 was reverted and rollout halted. Manual scale returned pool to target +4 nodes.

kevin: Customer comms status: draft sent to SOC for a quick review. Template: "We're investigating increased errors in EU-west routing impacting generations; fallback enabled and mitigation in progress; we'll update within 90 minutes." I'll post update when SOC thumbs up :eyes:

emily: Support queue check: no new high-severity tickets since the mitigation, a handful of retries showing in logs but no escalations. I'll flag any incoming with "INC-2026-034".

sara: Handoff checklist (ticklist): - primary/secondary assigned - runbook link included - rollback PR (#4231) noted - monitoring links: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/model-router, SLO dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/slo-models, PagerDuty INC-2026-034 - Action items: 1) infra to fix autoscaler probe logic + add unit test, 2) add extra logging around drainTimeout in router-agent, 3) postmortem owner: jon. Please ack if you got this and ping if anything changes :white_check_mark:

jon: ack. I will own the postmortem and aim to push an initial draft by EOD. I'll also open a follow-up ticket to add the probe unit test and link it to the rollback PR.

kevin: ack — I'll take customer comms and cover rotation for the next 8 hours. Phone for urgent: +1-555-0102.

incident-bot: Incident downgraded to P2 at 3123456800; watchlist set for 6 hours. Logs and alert snapshots attached to INC-2026-034.

sara: Handing off to @jon for day ops. If anything spikes, page primary. End of handoff.
